provenance: Public eICU demo zero-row planning context and recorded model answer text only. Context changes: remove local cohort paths and creation timestamp; replace display cohort name. All population, source, grouping and missingness authority metadata are preserved. No patient rows, headers or credentials. Repeated transport requests with the same cassette key are represented once.

context.research_question: eICU demo 中，入 ICU 时 80 岁及以上的患者占多大比例？他们的院内死亡率是多少？

exposure_groups.description: Ordinal groups of age stated by the study, as level codes: 1 = 80 岁以下; 2 = 80 岁及以上

variables.name: patient_stay_id
variables.description: Host-verified unique ICU-stay identity. Derive the patient cluster only from the prefix before ':s'; never report identifier values.

variables.name: death
pitfalls: ICU mortality vs hospital mortality vs 28-day mortality are NOT interchangeable; record which one is in use.
clinical_caveats: ICU mortality vs hospital mortality vs 28-day mortality are NOT interchangeable; record which one is in use.
For this analysis, 'death' retains its owner-issued clinical definition ('in hospital mortality'), which agrees with the requested hospital mortality.
cross_database_notes: Do not silently substitute ICU, hospital, 28-day, or 30-day mortality for one another when using 'death'.

variables.name: age_group_x1
variables.description: Ordinal groups of age stated by the study, as level codes: 1 = 80 岁以下; 2 = 80 岁及以上

time_windows.name: icu_admission_0_24h
time_windows.rationale: Outer feature-materialization window bound by the host before this run; the cohort carries no observation outside it.
